# All Nobel Prizes

Between 1901 and 2026, the Nobel Prizes and the Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel were awarded 639 times to 1,036 people and organisations. method.title: Source Grounded Bridge Expansion
method.rationale: Keep v007's routing and scope safeguards, but add a conditional discovery path for predicates expressed through intermediate entities rather than the requested person's name. Search source-backed group, work, event or record relationships before guessing more familiar people.
